mask_encoding.80: colour-matched shoreline within 12 m outside OSM polygon

world_frame: x = (easting - affine[2]) / k, z = (northing - affine[5]) / k, k = 1.0 (scene.json crs_units_per_m or 1); x east, z north; mask pixel (col,row) -> x = (col+0.5)*1.1943, z = -(row+0.5)*1.1943

source.geometry: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (natural=water, landuse=reservoir/basin, waterway=*), (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL

note: No OSM water polygon inside the tile bounds; no water mask produced from colour alone (without an in-scene water sample there is no real colour model, and dark roofs/shadows would be false positives).
